related.label: #41: how a swap permanently fills a correct slot
related.excerpt: 02Why can we skip work?Start with two cells [2,1]. Indices start at 0: the first cell should hold 1 and the second should hold 2. Move the first cell’s 2 to index 1 by swapping it with 1, giving [1,2]. Both slots are filled, so 3 is missing. In general, value x belongs at index x−1. While 1≤x≤n and the destination is not already x, swap with that destination. Recheck the incoming value before advancing i.Each useful swap permanently fills at least one correct slot; a different value cannot displace it, so there are at most n swaps. If the destination already contains x, another swap would cycle; skip the duplicate. The first nums[i]≠i+1 then identifies the missing value.Once x reaches x−1 it stays there. Out-of-range values and extra copies fill no new valid destination; the remaining gaps identify the answer. related.excerpt: 03Choose among reachable suppliesWith one additional stop, which supply preserves the most future possibilities?Keep 25/10/[[10,15]]. Station 0 is at 10 ≤ reach=10, so first admit it to the candidate pool: reachable stations not yet used. Admission adds no fuel and no stops. Since reach<25, choose the largest supply, 15. Reach becomes 25 and stops becomes 1. The destination is now covered, so no more stations need admission.The invariant is a fact preserved by every operation: reach equals starting fuel plus all chosen supplies; no station is chosen twice; the pool holds admitted, unchosen stations. Before each choice, admit all remaining stations with position ≤ reach. Stations strictly beyond reach stay out. If the pool is empty while reach<target, no new supply can be reached, so return −1.Why is the largest supply safe? Suppose another stop is needed and g is the largest reachable unchosen supply. The first stop o of any feasible continuation is also currently reachable. If that continuation omits g, replace o with g: fuel does not decrease, so later stops remain reachable. If it already includes g, keep the selected set and account for g first in the supply plan. Actual driving still follows increasing position: all stations before g are already within the current reach. Since g was already reachable and capacity is unlimited, this never reduces the reachable distance at any step or increases the stop count. Thus some optimal continuation starts with g; repeat this exchange for each choice.Keep the default case and complete the next operation: compare admission with selection. related.label: #871：交换论证如何支持最大油量选择
related.excerpt: 03只从可达补给中选择这一步要回答：同样增加一次停靠，选哪份油能保留最多后续可能？仍用 25/10/[[10,15]]：第 0 站位置 10 ≤ reach=10，因此先记入“候选池”（已经可达、尚未使用的站）。这一步不加油、不增加次数。reach<25 才需要选择：池中最大油量是 15，取走后 reach=25，次数变为 1。此时已经到终点，不必再收集站点。保持的事实（不变量）：reach=初始油量+所有已选站油量；每站至多选择一次；候选池只有已纳入、尚未选的站。在每次选择之前，先纳入所有位置 ≤ reach 的剩余站，严格大于 reach 的站必须留在池外。若池空且 reach<target，就没有任何可到达的新补给，返回 −1。为什么选最大的安全？设还需要加油，g 是当前可达且未用的最大油量站。任何可行续行的第一站 o 也必在当前可达范围内。若续行不用 g，用 g 换掉 o，增加的油不少，后续每站仍可达；若续行已经包含 g，最终选站集合无需更改，只需在规划中先计入 g。实际行驶仍按位置递增；g 之前的站本来就在当前可达范围内。因为 g 本来就可达且油箱无限，每一步都不会减少可达距离，停靠数不增加。于是至少有一个最优方案以 g 开始；重复交换即可保留最少次数。先保持默认例子点“完成下一操作”，观察“纳入”和“选择”有何不同。再换“早停反例”（会重启模拟），比较只纳入第 0 站与真正选中第 1 站。后退再前进应恢复同样的表格、距离和历史。教学模拟：JavaScript 生成完整操作快照，并不运行下方的 Python 提交。表格按道路位置排序；★ 仅表示刚操作的站，文字说明真实状态。候选池不按表格行序选择，而是按油量选最大。“选择”是补给规划顺序，不是车辆行驶顺序：最终按位置递增在选中的站加油，绝不倒车。场景（更换会重启）手算：恰好到站官方例 3：多轮补给早停反例无法到第一站无站，已能到终点连续恰好到站输入：target=25，startFuel=10；stations=[[10,15]]← 撤回一操作完成下一操作 →重置模拟查看模拟终点操作位置已完成操作 0/3；已选 0 个加油站当前可达距离 reach = 10 英里站号 / 位置油量（升）当前状态0 / 1015未纳入初始：reach=10，已选 0 次。尚未纳入站点。累计操作记录初始：reach=10，已选 0 次。尚未纳入站点。
